one_liner: Ecwid has a broad REST API with OAuth2 for public apps and non-expiring secret tokens for custom apps, but API access requires a paid store plan (free test-store upgrade available via email).
auth_notes: Public/external apps use OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow to obtain per-store access tokens; custom apps get non-expiring secret/public tokens from the app dashboard, sent as Bearer.
access_notes: Only stores on paid plans can access the API; no free plan or trial. Developers can email API support for a free upgrade of a test store.
blocker_notes: API requires a paid Ecwid plan; the builder must email Ecwid API support to get a free test-store upgrade, or pay (Starter about $5/mo).
